summary: M6_2O_SECURITY_REVIEW (mode=analysis_only). Security/PII review of slice M6.2O 'Out-of-band Backfill' — retroactive on-ledger certification of two already-shipped off-ledger changes (cumulative superset of M6.2M): B1 (raw PSID -> one-way salted psid_hash) and F2-6 (_smokes duck-coerce). In-scope rules M6-RULE-009/014/015; in-scope fail gates M6-FAIL-007 and M6-FAIL-008 (raw PII exposure — central to B1). ENTRY GATE verified in the state ledger: M6-P2306=RUNNING (row 226, order 224, DependsOn=M6-P2305); M6-P2305=PASS (boundary adversary, 24 executed vectors + a record-leg diff, 0 FAIL-007/008 breach); M6-P2304..2301=PASS; M6-P2300=SIGNED (M6.2O entry judge -> M6-P2209 SIGNED M6.2M slice judge). The ledger jumps M6.2M->M6.2O (no M6.2N rows — the process debt this slice closes). IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET_LOCKED.json LOCKED, staged-only. No missing/contradictory input -> not BLOCKED. METHOD: independent 2-layer masking scan (work/pii_scan_2o.py: canonical post_write_secret_scan patterns + stricter supplementary incl. a pepper keyword) over 258 files (impl/M6.2O app+tests, test-reports/M6.2O, boundary report, prior evidence M6-P2300..2305), plus line-level read of psid_hash.py, the resolver seam, attribution_context (psid->psid_hash), the _smokes coerce, and the B1 + import-gate tests. SCAN RESULT: CANONICAL 0 token shapes / 0 secret assignments / 0 raw user-id / 0 emails / 0 phones (authoritative pack gate clean); supplementary 3 broad-sk (carried risk-accept* prose), 3 DIGIT_RUN non-hex (all a SYNTHETIC placeholder numeric psid in tests/test_b1_psid_hash.py:62-63, used to assert the raw value is NOT in the hash output — proving one-wayness; not VN-phone-shaped, not real PII), 0 psid literals; REAL keyword=VALUE 1 (psid_hash.py:65 'pepper = resolve_pepper(...)' — a FUNCTION-CALL assignment, value=resolve_pepper, not a secret literal); REAL high-entropy tokens (risk-* excluded) 0. Zero raw PII, zero real secrets. The mock pepper (_MOCK_PEPPER = b'm6-staged-mock-pepper-not-a-secret-dev-only') is a LABELLED non-secret dev constant (correctly NOT a secret_ref). B1 psid_hash — a GENUINE FAIL-008 REDUCTION (verified on the code): AdsAttributionContext no longer has a raw psid field — it has psid_hash (attribution_context.py:77); to_public() + as_stored() carry ONLY psid_hash, and as_stored()=dict(to_public()) (no reversible raw psid kept at rest — the M6.2L mask(psid) was reversible/insufficient); resolver.resolve_live_session:104 hashes the raw psid at the seam (psid_hash=hash_psid(signals.get('psid'))) so the raw value never enters LiveContext or any durable row (lives only in RAM as the hash_psid arg); hash_psid = psid_hash: + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(pepper, psid)) one-way/deterministic-per-pepper/collision-sensitive; resolve_pepper FAIL-CLOSES in production (pepper env unset + production -> PsidHashPolicyError), with production an INJECTABLE call arg defaulting to the immutable PRODUCTION_FLAG so the fail-closed branch is testable WITHOUT flipping the flag (SMK-026 asserts PRODUCTION_FLAG=='OFF' after); the real pepper is a secret_ref (os.environ M6_PSID_HASH_PEPPER), the HMAC key, never logged/returned/emitted. FAIL-008 does NOT trip: no raw PSID on any durable/export surface, mechanism one-way + fail-closed. M6-OD-003 — THE HARD FORWARD GATE (where the residual risk sits; routed to owner, NOT self-decided): B1 is INTERNAL PII-minimization (pseudonymize psid at rest), NOT external send (external_send immutably OFF; B1 does not touch the M6.2D CAPI/Offline payload builder), so the internal mechanism is verifiable-clean NOW and needs no ratified external-send policy to be proven in staging. BUT two hard conditions gate any REAL deploy, both privacy-critical and both disclosed: (1) the staged _MOCK_PEPPER is a PUBLIC source constant so a staged synthetic psid_hash is brute-force reversible — one-wayness is real ONLY with the secret_ref pepper provisioned by the owner at deploy (a real deploy on the mock pepper would be a FAIL-008 exposure); (2) whether HMAC+pepper pseudonymization is LEGALLY SUFFICIENT, and the status of the M5-issued PSID_HASH_POLICY_M5_TMP (explicitly TEMPORARY), is a privacy/legal decision = M6-OD-003 (OPEN), which must be DECIDED before any real deploy / cross-module join (C7) / external send of hashed data. DISPOSITION: NOT BLOCKED (the staged mechanism proof completes cleanly; production_flag stays OFF; nothing missing/contradictory), but I do NOT certify B1 production-safe — it is a staged mechanism proof, and M6-OD-003 is the disclosed HARD forward condition I flag for the owner + the exit judge M6-P2309 (who must weigh whether the internal HMAC/pepper scheme needs M6-OD-003 sign-off before B1 is deemed closed). High-risk privacy item -> owner/privacy-legal decides. F2-6 duck-coerce — SECURITY-POSITIVE (FAIL-007 + closes a masking leak): _smokes (pack_assembler.py:154-185) rebuilds every provided smoke into a canonical SmokeResult from getattr fields, PINS smoke_id to spec.smoke_id, and recomputes recorded (never trusts caller .recorded) — closing the F-EVID-1 duck variant (duck .recorded=True + blank -> recomputed False -> NOT_READY), the COMP-4 crash (missing attrs -> getattr None -> not recorded), and the N4 smoke_id LEAK (a caller smoke_id carrying PII is discarded; the displayed row is the registry id). So the F-SEC-2K-1/N4 export-masking family SHRINKS (smoke_id slot now closed). IMPORT-SCAN GATE (security-positive, RULE-004): tests/test_no_http_client_import.py (attributed SECURITY_PII/OD-011) is an AST scan that fails the build if any app/**.py imports an HTTP/egress client (httpx/requests/aiohttp/urllib3/urllib.request/http.client) — a static complement to EXTERNAL_SEND=OFF keeping egress outbox-worker-only even after the OD-011 bind; non-vacuous (probes planted violations, clears urllib.parse). CONSENT: unchanged (M6.2O touches only the psid seam + evidence assembler); F-GROWTH-1 (CRM) + reactivation N6 subject-bind remain OPEN, out of scope, disclosed in M6.2J-GROWTH standing blocker. UNTRUSTED-INPUT: raw psid enters via the resolver signals seam (in-process, trusted — live-source sub-resolver at integration) and is hashed IMMEDIATELY; the evidence assembler + psid seam have NO channel caller (grep-confirmed boundary N3/N5). ACCESS CONTROL (doc §22 line 429): M6.2O adds NO admin API / worker authorization; the real pepper is owner-provisioned as a secret_ref at the M6-OD-011 integration step; the import-gate statically enforces no egress client; evidence-store access control (role hooks + operator-only state ledger) unchanged/enforced. FINDINGS (armed-not-fired; none trips FAIL-007/008; none is a live PII leak): F-SEC-2O-1 (carried masking-scope, SHRUNK) — messenger_thread_id/live_session_id/comment_id still export raw (B1 hashed only psid); the clearest-PII field psid is now hashed and the smoke_id slot is closed, leaving the live/comment/messenger trace-join ids (messenger_thread_id most identifying) -> M6-OD-012; F-EVID-6 (boundary N2, NEW) — no trace<->smoke binding: a genuine SMK-002 correlation/evidence trace can be mis-filed under the SMK-001 key (F2-6 pins smoke_id + kills the .recorded-lie but nothing binds the trace to its smoke); trusted-input -> CODER; F-EVID-4/F-EVID-5 (carried) status exported verbatim -> M6-OD-012, recorded!=passed -> CODER status=='PASS' gate; audit detail sink (boundary MC-6) unmasked, defended by caller discipline, no channel path plants a raw psid -> security note to monitor at OD-011 integration. CONSISTENCY: record-leg honesty verified (boundary §5 — the M6.2N->M6.2O app diff is a single file F2-6 _smokes; B1 carried unchanged; config.py byte-identical); B1 is a net privacy improvement shrinking the M6-OD-012 masking-scope debt. DOC-SYNC NOTE (honest OPEN, not a leak): M6-OD-013/M6-OD-014 + the M5 PSID_HASH_POLICY_M5_TMP are referenced by slice specs/code but not yet DECISION_REGISTER rows -> PM/analyst should record them. GOVERNANCE POSTURE UNCHANGED AND IMMUTABLE: global_gateway_state=BLOCKED, production_flag=OFF, external_send=OFF, HASH_POLICY_RATIFIED=False, all scale/learning flags False, config.py byte-identical to M6.2M. Analysis-only: no application code/test/migration/state-ledger/release-flag change; no CRM send, no commission, no Data-Mart trigger, no Core override, no scale/publish, no order-state/pricing; wrote only work/pii_scan_2o.py + the security report + this evidence JSON; no enabling value written anywhere. No raw secret/PII in this evidence (psid/pepper referenced by name only; the synthetic test psid not reproduced). status=PASS is my honest security self-report; it does NOT self-certify gate advancement (RULE-015) — the runner EVIDENCE_GATE and the slice Judge M6-P2309 decide closure, and the judge must weigh the M6-OD-003 sign-off for B1.
